guards: Timer lives inside $effect, which never runs during SSR; server render starts settled and visible.

verification.evidence: 0 errors / 0 warnings in toast files (whole-project run).

verification.purpose: Port gates: files, verbatim CSS, prop parity, manifest

gaps: Phase 1 still-port by design: no motion library wired. The enter rise (opacity/y/scale spring), the exit sink-or-throw, the check-path draw-in, the title/description blur cross-fade (Swap/popLayout) and the HeightFrame content-height spring all render as static end-states; mount/unmount is instant.
Drag-to-dismiss is omitted in Phase 1 (no swipe distance/velocity handling, no spring-home on release, no reduced-motion drag disable). Dismissal is via the close button and the duration timer only.
Hydration enter behaviour (server-rendered toasts start settled, client-mounted ones rise in) collapses to one path: everything renders settled.

Outgoing-copy aria-hidden handoff (Swap hides the leaving copy from assistive tech mid-fade) has no leaving copy in Phase 1, so there is nothing to hide; the live region always reads the current text.
